_style: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon background art for an animated web series. Clean dark ink outlines with a slightly uneven hand-drawn line, flat muted colours with simple soft cel shading, a gentle paper grain. Straight, readable perspective, eye-level camera unless stated. Empty scene: no people, no characters, no animals, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable signs (sign panels are blank coloured shapes).
concourse: Inside a two-level suburban shopping mall at night, after closing. A long wide main hallway runs into the distance with a vanishing point slightly left of centre. Shop fronts line both sides on both levels, each one closed with a steel roll-down security grille of thin vertical bars. A glass railing runs along the upper level. A still escalator sits in the middle distance. Above, a long arched glass skylight ceiling shows a dark blue night sky. Dim cool night lighting with a few warm pools of light from ceiling lamps. A shiny pale tiled floor with soft reflections fills the bottom third of the image and is empty. Colours: deep blues, teal, warm amber accents.
exterior: Night exterior of a big suburban shopping mall seen from the edge of its parking lot. A long low beige building with a tall glass entrance atrium in the centre glowing softly from inside, a blank sign panel above the entrance. An almost empty parking lot with painted lines and a few tall lamp posts casting orange pools of light. Dark blue starry sky, a few trees. The ground fills the bottom third.
office: A small mall security office at night. On the back wall, a grid of nine small CCTV monitors (three rows of three) glowing with grainy blue-grey camera views of empty hallways. A long desk below them with a keyboard, a coffee mug, a walkie-talkie charger and scattered papers, a black rolling office chair, a metal key cabinet on the right wall, a door on the left. Dim room lit mainly by the monitor glow. Cool blue light with one warm desk lamp.
garage: An underground concrete parking garage at night, seen from a high corner like a security camera looking down. Grey concrete pillars, painted parking lines, a few parked cars, a wide concrete ramp rising up from the right side toward the back, buzzing fluorescent ceiling lights with pale green-white light. The floor in the middle is empty and fills most of the image.
foodcourt: An indoor shopping mall food court at night, after closing. Rows of small tables with chairs in the foreground and middle ground. On the left, a row of closed food counters with their shutters pulled down and blank coloured sign panels. On the right, a huge floor-to-ceiling glass wall with a pair of glass double doors in the middle, looking out onto a dark parking lot with orange lamp posts. Dim cool light, reflections on the glass and on the pale tiled floor.
pharmacy: A pharmacy shop front inside a shopping mall at night, seen straight on from the mall hallway. The whole front is glass: big display windows and a glass door in the middle. Inside, aisles of shelves full of small colourful medicine boxes and bottles, and a counter at the back. A green cross shape glows above the entrance on a blank sign panel. Dim night light, reflections on the glass, pale tiled hallway floor in the foreground.
deptstore: Inside the ground floor of a huge department store at night. A wide open sales floor with display beds made up with pillows and duvets on the left, clothing racks on the right, and an escalator rising up to a second floor balcony in the centre background. Several wide open entrances to the mall hallway along the back wall. Very large, open and empty, dim cool lighting with a few warm lamps on the display beds. Pale floor in the foreground.
sportsfront: A sporting goods shop front inside a shopping mall at night, seen straight on from the mall hallway. One single wide rectangular entrance opening in the centre with a steel roll-down security grille rolled all the way up into a slot at the top, so the entrance is open. Side walls of the shop front are solid painted panels, no glass. Inside you can see camping tents set up on display, a rack of aluminium baseball bats, a wall of backpacks and water bottles, and treadmills. A blank orange sign panel above the entrance. Dim night light, pale tiled hallway floor in the foreground.
sportsinside: Inside a sporting goods store at night, dark, seen from the back of the shop looking toward its entrance. In the centre background, the shop's single wide rectangular entrance opening shows the dimly lit mall hallway beyond, with a pale tiled floor. In the shop: two dome camping tents set up on display in the middle ground, a row of treadmills along the left wall, a rack of baseball bats and shelves of backpacks and water bottles on the right wall. Very dark blue shadows inside the shop, faint cool light spilling in through the entrance across the floor. The floor in the foreground is empty.
busstop: A quiet suburban street on a sunny afternoon. A big yellow school bus is stopped at the curb on the right side of the image, its door open and its red stop-sign arm out. Small friendly houses with lawns and leafy trees behind a sidewalk, a mailbox, a few autumn leaves. Warm golden late-afternoon light, long soft shadows. A wide empty sidewalk and grass strip fill the bottom third.
